correctness.rationale: The exact periodic Fourier representation yields a paired-phase branch difference 2 sin(theta)[B+2E cos(theta)] and hence a unique transverse crossing iff |B|<2|E| with E≠0. For one/two arbitrary-rate serial stages b(2)/b(1)=2∏(lambda_j²+omega²)/(lambda_j²+4omega²)<2, excluding crossing because epsilon<q. For three equal rates b3(k)=k sqrt(x)(3-k²x)/(1+k²x)^3 yields R(x)<rho; G derivative is strictly negative and boundary limits provide exactly two roots. At x=3 B=0 and E=-9sqrt(3)epsilon²/2197, leading by exact quadrature to opposite lobe areas 12sqrt(3)epsilon³/2197. Rational polynomial identity, rational brackets, transfer checks, and branch diagnostics pass directly from included checker.py; finite tests are supporting only.

value.rationale: Hydrology recognizes figure-eight discharge/sediment loops but their mechanisms and scalar hysteresis indices are ambiguous. The result gives an exact minimal serial-storage mechanism under a single positive monotone quadratic supply, a complete dimensionless frequency window, and a concrete counterexample to interpreting zero signed hysteresis area as absence of geometric memory. This is a motivated reduced-model structural benchmark, not a field calibration or a general novel existence claim for figure-eight loops.
